description:
The `sim_runner` binary does not stop on SIGINT when no checkpoint directory is set, because the sequential path never checks the interrupt flag, and parallel product-code curves do not read the CSV resume cache. `@/inv/campaign-resumability` requires an interrupted run to continue without repeating completed work.

## Background

Found while writing the simulation campaign how-to.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `sim_runner` stops at the next point boundary on SIGINT on the sequential and the parallel path, with and without a checkpoint directory, covered by a test.
- [hard] REQ-02: A resumed parallel product-code curve reuses every completed point from the CSV resume cache and produces the same results as an uninterrupted run with the same seed, covered by a test.
title: sim_runner ignores SIGINT and parallel product curves skip the resume cache
